smoke_test.description: Quick sanity check (~5 min, any GPU)

table1_cold_swap_ppl.notes: Use fp32 for cold-swap accuracy. bf16 rounding compounds through 30+ layers.

table2_finetuned_ppl.train: python benchmarks/train_coda.py --model mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.3 --max-steps 2000 --bounded-steps 600 --bounded-config medium --seq-len 8192 --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 8 --head-norm-mode identity --dtype bf16 --output-dir results/training
table2_finetuned_ppl.eval: python benchmarks/eval_llm.py --model mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.3 --experiment perplexity --adapter-weights results/training/phase2/best/coda_adapters.pt --head-norm-mode identity --dtype bf16
table2_finetuned_ppl.notes: Training at seq_len=8192 is critical. Models trained at 2048 show catastrophic PPL blowup beyond training length.

ablation_diff_attn.description: Differential attention contribution -- GQA+bounded vs CoDA+bounded (~4 hours)
commands: python benchmarks/train_coda.py --model mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.3 --max-steps 0 --bounded-steps 1200 --no-differential --bounded-config medium --seq-len 2048 --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 8 --head-norm-mode identity --dtype bf16 --output-dir results/ablation_gqa

python benchmarks/train_coda.py --model mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.3 --max-steps 1200 --bounded-steps 1200 --bounded-config medium --seq-len 2048 --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 8 --head-norm-mode identity --dtype bf16 --output-dir results/ablation_coda

ablation_memory_banks.description: Memory bank config sweep -- window-only vs tiny vs medium vs large
ablation_memory_banks.command: python benchmarks/eval_llm.py --model mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.3 --experiment perplexity --bounded-configs window-only,tiny,medium,large --adapter-weights path/to/coda_adapters.pt --head-norm-mode identity --dtype bf16
ablation_memory_banks.notes: Requires trained adapter weights. Use published checkpoint or train with table2_finetuned_ppl.
